clubhouse.text: Build the clubhouse: the directory `~/{{clubDir}}`, where **only you** may read, write and enter (`rwx------`).
clubhouse.hint: Create the directory with `mkdir` and change the permissions with `chmod`. r = 4, w = 2, x = 1 – and the group and others get 0.

knock.text: Write the doorkeeper script `~/{{clubDir}}/{{knockScript}}`, which prints the club's password with `echo`. Make it executable and run it.
knock.hint: Write the line to the file with `echo '…' > file` (single quotes around the line), make it executable with `chmod +x` and run it with its path, e.g. `./{{knockScript}}` when you're in the clubhouse.

variable.text: Create the environment variable `{{clubVar}}` with the full path to the clubhouse, so that `cd ${{clubVar}}` takes you there.
variable.hint: `export NAME=value` – no spaces around `=`. The value can be `~/{{clubDir}}` or `$HOME/{{clubDir}}`.

wardrobe.text: Hide a secret entrance: a symbolic link `~/{{documents}}/{{wardrobe}}` that leads straight into the clubhouse.
wardrobe.hint: `ln -s TARGET LINKNAME` – the target first. With an absolute path as the target it doesn't matter where you are.

night-watch.text: Post a night watch: run `sleep 3600` in the background, so that it keeps watch for an hour – and keeps going even if you log out.
night-watch.hint: `&` at the end of the line runs the command in the background, and `nohup` at the start makes it survive you logging out.

backup.text: Make a backup of the whole clubhouse: the compressed archive `~/{{clubBackup}}`.
backup.hint: Go to your home directory and use `tar` with `c` (create), `z` (gzip) and `f` followed by the archive's name – and the directory to pack last.

dismiss.text: Morning has come: send the night watch home by ending the process.
dismiss.hint: `jobs` shows the night watch's job number and `ps` its PID. End it with `kill %NUMBER`, `kill PID` or `pkill sleep`.
